name: projects-webmcp-extension
description: Wornpage Projects demo with a preserved WebMCP baseline and a Nebius Token Factory edition.

scripts.dev:nebius: npm run build:nebius && wrangler dev --config wrangler.nebius.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.test:nebius: node --test tests/nebius-api.test.mjs tests/nebius-client.test.mjs tests/nebius-plan.test.mjs tests/nebius-project-state.test.mjs tests/nebius-plan-client.test.mjs tests/nebius-replan.test.mjs tests/nebius-replan-state.test.mjs tests/nebius-replan-client.test.mjs tests/nebius-routing.test.mjs tests/nebius-project-starters.test.mjs tests/nebius-project-progress.test.mjs tests/nebius-project-completion.test.mjs
scripts.verify:nebius: npm run test:manifest && npm run test:nebius && npm run check && npm run build:nebius && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.nebius.jsonc --outdir dist/nebius-worker && npm run test:nebius:runtime
scripts.build:pages: npm --prefix svelte-frontend ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build
scripts.test:browser: node scripts/calibrate-work-first-recording.mjs && node scripts/work-interaction-polish-smoke.mjs && node scripts/webmcp-header-responsive-smoke.mjs && node scripts/offline-browser-smoke.mjs && node scripts/portability-browser-smoke.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run test:manifest && npm run check && npm run test:webmcp && npm run build && npm run test:social-card && npm run test:artifact
